title: Uniform Factor-Balancedness in Arnoux-Rauzy Words
summary: We characterize uniform factor-balancedness in Arnoux-Rauzy words, generalizing the work of Espinoza, Popoli, and Stipulanti on ternary alphabets to finite alphabets of any size. In particular, we prove that an Arnoux-Rauzy word $\mathbf{x}$ is uniformly factor-balanced if and only if $\mathbf{x}$ has bounded weak partial quotients.
